name: RAPIDS GPU Dev Container
postCreateCommand:
apt-get update && apt-get install -y git openssh-client && \
    conda create -n my_project_env python=3.11 -y && \
    conda install -n my_project_env -c conda-forge ipykernel ipywidgets pandas numpy scipy matplotlib seaborn plotly scikit-learn optuna nodejs yarn -y && \
    conda run -n my_project_env pip install tensorflow==2.16.2 welly lasio striplog dash missingno optuna-dashboard optuna-integration scikeras && \
    conda run -n my_project_env python -m ipykernel install --name rapids --display-name 'Python (RAPIDS)'
